annoyed.title: My land yacht
annoyed.what: Caption says 'a canvas sail on a boom', but the picture shows no boom: the sail's lower corner just ends in the air above the deck, attached only along a single mast.

annoyed.title: A campfire in the wind
annoyed.what: The campfire, which is the subject, is small and hidden behind a cluster of tall upright brown planks and a grass tuft in the foreground in every frame (storyboard all 16 frames; at-25, at-50, at-75). You only see the flame through the gaps between the boards.

annoyed.title: My first motor
annoyed.what: Caption says 'two stones', but the two big parts on the axle are flat black discs that look like rubber wheels, not stone (all frames, at-25, at-50).

annoyed.title: Where I rushed it
annoyed.what: Plain shapes on bare ground: a dark brown box with two orange sticks on flat green, with nothing of the island around it (frames 1-5).

annoyed.title: Chipping a stone to change its note
annoyed.what: The pebble moves with no visible cause: it hops around among the bird's toes and floats in the air beside its feet (frames 1-11). Nothing throws, drops or carries it, and the bird's feet never move.

annoyed.title: Putting past a magnet stone
annoyed.what: Nothing starts the balls: the three sit stacked in the far left corner (storyboard frame 1) and leave one at a time with no push, release or visible tilt of the tray, so 'roll down my sand tray' shows no cause.

annoyed.title: I swallow what I hit
annoyed.what: The swallow is never shown: in frame 2 a green bubble wraps the yellow bird, and by frame 3 the crab has simply vanished from the left with no contact or engulfing in between.

annoyed.title: A top over a ring of lodestone
annoyed.what: The plate moves with no hand: it lowers by itself (frames 1-6).
